events.text: The first tea of spring is picked. The best leaves sell for their weight in silver.

effects.log: Green fingers and fair pay. (+8 taels)

choices.text: Buy a small tin of the best

effects.log: The finest tea you will drink all year. (−6 taels)

events.text: Thieves raid a tea estate at night to steal the first flush.

ok.log: The estate owner pays you in tea and silver. (+10 taels)

fail.log: They escape with half the harvest.

effects.log: Nothing more is stolen.

events.text: A tea master performs a ceremony so precise it looks like a martial form.

effects.log: Stillness in motion. It helps your forms.
You spill. The master smiles and pours again.

events.text: Tea houses compete to brew the best cup. You are asked to judge.

effects.log: The humblest tea house wins. The big ones grumble.
A scandal, but a fun one.

events.text: The tea road through the mountains is steep and full of bandits.

effects.log: A week of mountain paths. (+12 taels)
Slower, but you sleep at night.

events.text: Tea pickers sing call-and-response songs across the terraces.

effects.log: The whole hillside laughs.
You hum them for years.

events.text: Someone has poisoned a batch of tea meant for a sect elder.

ok.log: You catch the smell. The elder's life is saved.

fail.log: You taste it. A bad week.

choices.text: Warn the elder to be careful

effects.log: He has his tea tasted. The poisoner is found.

events.text: Hail destroys a small farmer's tea terraces.

effects.log: Two years until the first harvest. He will remember you.

choices.text: Buy his remaining tea at a fair price

effects.log: He can feed his family. (−5 taels)

events.text: You are allowed to pick tea with the grown-ups. Only the top two leaves and a bud.

effects.log: Your basket is small and perfect.
Your basket is big and wrong. Everyone laughs.

events.text: A wild tea tree on a cliff, said to be a thousand years old.

effects.log: The tea tastes like the mountain itself.
Some things should stay wild.

events.text: A tea house owner offers you a job keeping order in the evenings.

effects.log: Quiet nights and free tea. (+10 taels)
Tea houses are for sitting in, not guarding.

events.text: The harvest ends. The terraces rest.

choices.text: Brew the last of the first flush

effects.log: Spring, in a cup.

choices.text: Gift some tea to an old master

effects.log: He is delighted.
